content.short: Zombits is a Cardano NFT collection of 10,000 unique zombie-themed collectibles with rare traits and lore.
content.description: Zombits is a Cardano NFT collection made up of 10,000 unique crypto collectibles. Each Zombit has its own visual traits and rarity profile, giving collectors a way to compare characters across the collection. The project later expanded its universe with Humanbit NFTs, adding another character set connected to the broader Zombits story. Its core appeal is classic collectible NFT ownership on Cardano, supported by trait scarcity, community identity, and future collection-based lore for holders and fans.
